model_annotation:
The line plot illustrates the performance on the CliKT dataset across different co-occurrence number groups. 
The y-axis is labeled with percentage values, has a linear scale, and ranges from 55% to 65%. 
The x-axis is categorical with Base, MEND, FT, IKE, MERIT, and ROME. 
The plot contains six lines with different colors and marker shapes: Base is represented by a black line with markers; MEND, by a red line with square markers; FT, by a teal line with circle markers; IKE, by an orange line with triangle-up markers; MERIT, by a purple line with diamond markers; and ROME, by a green line with triangle-right markers. 
The ROME line starts at approximately 59% and increases to approximately 63.5%. The MERIT line starts at approximately 59% and increases to approximately 62.5%. The MEND line starts at approximately 57% and increases to approximately 61%. The FT line remains steady at approximately 58.5%. The IKE line starts at approximately 56% and increases to approximately 59%. The Base line starts at approximately 56% and remains steady at approximately 56%.
